description: Lists breadboardhub's hardware interview practice problems: Verilog and RTL questions of the kind asked in FPGA, ASIC and digital design interviews, such as counters, FIFOs, state machines and arbiters, each graded by a hidden test. Filters by difficulty, topic, kind ("design" to write a module, "find-the-bug" to write a test that catches buggy versions) or the starter set. Returns each problem's id, title, difficulty, topics, suggested minutes and page link. Free, with no daily limit.

kind.description: "design": write a module that passes the hidden test. "find-the-bug": write a test that passes the correct design and fails every buggy version.

starter.description: Only the starter problems, a good first set.

topic.description: Only problems with this topic, such as "fsm", "fifo" or "counter" (up to 40 characters).

name: list_practice_problems
title: List hardware interview practice problems
